name: rebuild both samplers
command: cat /tmp/fwd.c | ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cat > ~/bonsai2/asm/fwd.c' 2>&1; cat /tmp/fwd8.c | ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cat > ~/bonsai2/asm/fwd8.c && cd ~/bonsai2/asm && LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -O2 -fopenmp -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -c fwd.c -o fwd.o 2>&1 | grep -i " error" | head -3; gcc -O2 -march=armv8.2-a+dotprod -c fwd8.c -o fwd8.o 2>&1 | grep -i " error" | head -3; gcc -O2 -fopenmp -o fwd_mt fwd.o fwd_neon_mt.o fwht.S -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm && gcc -O2 -o fwd8 fwd8.o fwd8_pq2.o -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm && echo BUILD_OK' 2>&1 | head -6
